events.description: A child survives because a sound, gesture, or taboo prevents escalation.
A failed signal or misread posture leads to death.
A crystal fractures after mishandling, overload, or a wrong sequence.
A cave responds to breath, echo, posture, or proximity.
A material emits or conducts enough force to ignite.
A wound stabilizes through correct handling, song, pressure, or material contact.
A metal gives a dangerous or false resonance.
A mourning form survives because omission is socially or materially dangerous.
A word crosses groups and changes because the receiving group maps it differently.
Washing, sorting, heat, or sequence separates mixed matter into a safer state.
A threshold-like effect appears before anyone understands it as technical.
